{"question":"Let us consider the linear system with 4 variables depending on the real parameter k ∈ R

	x - t = 0
	-x + 2y + 2z + t = 4
	y + z = k

Find the right statement.","options":{"A":"(a) If k = 2 the system admits ∞² solutions.","B":"(b) If k = 2 the system admits ∞¹ solutions.","C":"(c) If k ≠ 2 the system admits only one solutions.","D":"(d) For any k ∈ R the system does not admit any solution."},"correct":null}
